slides.title: Peptide hormones and growth factors
slides.text: WADA expanded the S1, S2, S4 and S6 class descriptions for 2026, to help identify banned substances and their relatives.

slides.title: BPC-157 sits in a different class
slides.text: BPC-157 isn't listed as a 'peptide hormone' — it falls under S0, the catch-all class for non-approved substances, alongside DNP and drugs still in clinical trials.
Class S0 bans any pharmacological substance that isn't an approved drug — whether or not it has its own named entry on the list.
